capabilities: Chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent in a side panel
Run bash, file edits and web search inside the vault
Rewrite, summarize or explain selected text with preview before writing
Review changed Markdown files with a diff and undo one file or a whole run
Run one instruction across several notes in a batch
extras: Needs the DSH CLI and Node.js installed; the plugin keeps an isolated DSH home and never pollutes ~/.dsh. A plugin-only API key is stored in the local plugin data file. The plugin checks for updates but never downloads or installs them.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to hand a task to an autonomous agent that can read, edit and search the notes in a vault on its own.

relations.evidence: A Claudian-style AI assistant plugin for Obsidian
it calls DeepSeek Harness directly from the side panel

summary: Side-panel chat that runs a DeepSeek Harness agent in your vault, letting it run bash, edit files and search the web, with review and undo.
